+"""``SGLANG_SPEC_STEP_GRAPH_FUSED_INPUT_COPY``: one launch for a step-graph replay's input copies.
+
+``_copy_step_inputs`` copies the live step inputs into the graph's static
+buffers. With the small-tensor copy it is one launch when every tensor
+qualifies ("fused"), one launch for the small tensors plus a copy per large
+one ("partial", batch sizes above 1), and per-tensor copies otherwise (a tensor
+that does not qualify, or a live tensor aliasing a static buffer). The static
+buffers hold the same bytes either way.
+"""
+
+import unittest
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.kernels.ops.memory.small_copy import try_small_copy
+from sglang.srt.speculative.eagle_step_cuda_graph_runner import _copy_step_inputs
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cuda_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cuda_ci(est_time=9, stage="base-b", runner_config="1-gpu-small")
+
+HIDDEN = 6144
+TOPK = 2048
+
+
+def _random(shape, dtype, generator):
+    """A tensor of random bit patterns (NaN / inf payloads included for floats)."""
+    numel = 1
+    for d in shape:
+        numel *= d
+    nbytes = numel * torch.empty((), dtype=dtype).element_size()
+    raw = torch.randint(
+        0, 256, (nbytes,), dtype=torch.uint8, device="cuda", generator=generator
+    )
+    if dtype == torch.bool:
+        raw = raw % 2
+    return raw.view(dtype).view(shape)
+
+
+def _step_inputs(bs, generator):
+    """Live inputs shaped like an EAGLE topk-1 decode step's per-step tensors."""
+    specs = [
+        ((bs,), torch.int64),  # req_pool_indices
+        ((bs,), torch.int64),  # seq_lens
+        ((bs,), torch.int32),  # orig_seq_lens
+        ((bs, 1), torch.int64),  # top-k index
+        ((bs, TOPK), torch.int32),  # sparse-attention top-k seed rows
+        ((bs,), torch.int64),  # verified ids
+        ((bs, HIDDEN), torch.bfloat16),  # hidden states
+        ((bs, 1), torch.float32),  # top-k probabilities
+        ((bs, 1), torch.float32),  # temperatures
+        ((bs,), torch.float32),  # top-p
+        ((bs,), torch.int32),  # top-k
+        ((bs,), torch.float32),  # min-p
+        ((bs,), torch.bool),  # a per-request flag
+    ]
+    live = [_random(shape, dtype, generator) for shape, dtype in specs]
+    static = [torch.empty_like(t) for t in live]
+    return static, live
+
+
+def _bytes(tensor):
+    return tensor.contiguous().view(-1).view(torch.uint8)
+
+
+@unittest.skipUnless(torch.cuda.is_available(), "requires CUDA")
+class TestStepGraphFusedInputCopy(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_fused_equals_per_tensor(self):
+        generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(1234)
+        for bs in (1, 2, 4, 8):
+            with self.subTest(bs=bs):
+                static, live = _step_inputs(bs, generator)
+                ref = [torch.empty_like(t) for t in live]
+                self.assertEqual(_copy_step_inputs(ref, live, None), "per_tensor")
+                # bs 1: every tensor fits the one-launch copy; larger batches
+                # exceed its element limit with the hidden states / top-k rows.
+                want = "fused" if bs == 1 else "partial"
+                self.assertEqual(_copy_step_inputs(static, live, try_small_copy), want)
+                torch.cuda.synchronize()
+                for i, (r, dst, src) in enumerate(zip(ref, static, live)):
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        (dst.shape, dst.dtype, dst.stride()),
+                        (src.shape, src.dtype, src.stride()),
+                    )
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.equal(_bytes(r), _bytes(src)), f"ref {i}")
+                    self.assertTrue(torch.equal(_bytes(dst), _bytes(src)), f"fused {i}")
+
+    def test_repeated_replays_overwrite(self):
+        generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(7)
+        static, live = _step_inputs(1, generator)
+        for _ in range(3):
+            _, fresh = _step_inputs(1, generator)
+            for src, new in zip(live, fresh):
+                src.copy_(new)
+            self.assertEqual(_copy_step_inputs(static, live, try_small_copy), "fused")
+            torch.cuda.synchronize()
+            for dst, src in zip(static, live):
+                self.assertTrue(torch.equal(_bytes(dst), _bytes(src)))
+
+    def test_declines_to_per_tensor_copies(self):
+        generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(11)
+        static, live = _step_inputs(1, generator)
+        # A 3-d tensor does not qualify for the one-launch copy: every tensor
+        # is then copied per tensor, with the same bytes.
+        live.append(_random((1, 2, 3), torch.float32, generator))
+        static.append(torch.empty_like(live[-1]))
+        self.assertEqual(_copy_step_inputs(static, live, try_small_copy), "per_tensor")
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        for dst, src in zip(static, live):
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(_bytes(dst), _bytes(src)))
+
+    def test_shared_memory_keeps_per_tensor_order(self):
+        generator = torch.Generator(device="cuda").manual_seed(5)
+        static, live = _step_inputs(2, generator)
+        # A live tensor that is a view of a static buffer: the partial path
+        # would reorder the copies, so the per-tensor copies run in list order
+        # (static[0] receives static[1]'s bytes from before its own copy).
+        live[0] = static[1].view(-1)[: live[0].numel()].view(torch.int64)
+        want = [_bytes(t).clone() for t in live]
+        self.assertEqual(_copy_step_inputs(static, live, try_small_copy), "per_tensor")
+        torch.cuda.synchronize()
+        for i, (dst, ref) in enumerate(zip(static, want)):
+            self.assertTrue(torch.equal(_bytes(dst), ref), f"tensor {i}")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+"""``--enable-speculative-step-cuda-graph`` turns on its six fused pieces.
+
+CPU only. A launch's server args (parsed from the command line, through the
+speculative resolution step, and published as a scheduler process publishes
+them) decide what each piece's switch reads:
+  * the flag alone: every piece is on;
+  * the flag and one switch set to 0: only that piece is off;
+  * no flag, a setup that turns the flag off at startup, or no published
+    config: every piece is off;
+  * a switch set to 1 without the flag: that piece is on (a test override).
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import contextlib
+import os
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest import mock
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.overrides import resolution_result
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.speculative_hook import handle_speculative_decoding
+from sglang.srt.environ import envs
+from sglang.srt.runtime_context import (
+    ParallelContext,
+    RuntimeContext,
+    create_context,
+    use_context,
+)
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.srt.speculative import eagle_step_cuda_graph_runner as runner_module
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=5, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+SWITCHES = (
+    envs.SGLANG_SPEC_PACKED_VERIFY_BROADCAST,
+    envs.SGLANG_SPEC_LEAN_SAMPLED_VERIFY,
+    envs.SGLANG_SPEC_CHUNKED_VERIFY_SAMPLING,
+    envs.SGLANG_SPEC_FUSED_RELAY,
+    envs.SGLANG_SPEC_FUSED_DRAFT_EXTEND_TAIL,
+    envs.SGLANG_SPEC_STEP_GRAPH_FUSED_INPUT_COPY,
+)
+
+
+def _argv(flag, topk=1, draft_tokens=4):
+    """An EAGLE launch command line, with or without the flag."""
+    argv = ["--model-path", "dummy", "--device", "cuda"]
+    argv += ["--speculative-algorithm", "EAGLE", "--speculative-num-steps", "3"]
+    argv += ["--speculative-eagle-topk", str(topk)]
+    argv += ["--speculative-num-draft-tokens", str(draft_tokens)]
+    return argv + (["--enable-speculative-step-cuda-graph"] if flag else [])
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def _cuda_platform(cuda=True):
+    """Pretend to run on CUDA with cuda-python and the native allocator."""
+    with (
+        mock.patch.object(runner_module, "is_cuda", return_value=cuda),
+        mock.patch.object(runner_module, "_cuda_python_available", return_value=True),
+        mock.patch.object(torch.cuda, "get_allocator_backend", return_value="native"),
+    ):
+        yield
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def _no_switch_set():
+    """None of the six switches is set; the environment is restored after."""
+    with mock.patch.dict(os.environ):
+        for switch in SWITCHES:
+            switch.clear()
+        yield
+
+
+def _launch(argv, cuda=True):
+    """Server args parsed from ``argv``, through the launch's speculative
+    resolution step (the step that keeps the flag or turns it off)."""
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    ServerArgs.add_cli_args(parser)
+    args = ServerArgs.from_cli_args(parser.parse_args(argv))
+    args._model_config = SimpleNamespace(
+        hf_config=SimpleNamespace(architectures=["LlamaForCausalLM"])
+    )
+    with _cuda_platform(cuda):
+        handle_speculative_decoding(args)
+    return args
+
+
+@contextlib.contextmanager
+def _scheduler_process(args):
+    """The config a scheduler process publishes for ``args``."""
+    with use_context(create_context(args, role="scheduler")):
+        yield
+
+
+def _values():
+    return {switch.name: switch.get() for switch in SWITCHES}
+
+
+class TestSwitchesFollowTheFlag(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_flag_alone_turns_every_piece_on(self):
+        args = _launch(_argv(flag=True))
+        self.assertTrue(resolution_result(args, "enable_speculative_step_cuda_graph"))
+        with _no_switch_set(), _scheduler_process(args):
+            self.assertEqual(_values(), {switch.name: True for switch in SWITCHES})
+
+    def test_each_override_turns_only_its_piece_off(self):
+        args = _launch(_argv(flag=True))
+        with _no_switch_set(), _scheduler_process(args):
+            for off in SWITCHES:
+                with self.subTest(switch=off.name):
+                    with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {off.name: "0"}):
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            _values(),
+                            {switch.name: switch is not off for switch in SWITCHES},
+                        )
+
+    def test_without_the_flag_every_piece_is_off(self):
+        args = _launch(_argv(flag=False))
+        self.assertFalse(resolution_result(args, "enable_speculative_step_cuda_graph"))
+        all_off = {switch.name: False for switch in SWITCHES}
+        with _no_switch_set():
+            with _scheduler_process(args):
+                self.assertEqual(_values(), all_off)
+            # No server config published (tools, unit tests).
+            with use_context(RuntimeContext(parallel=ParallelContext())):
+                self.assertEqual(_values(), all_off)
+
+    def test_flag_turned_off_at_startup_turns_every_piece_off(self):
+        cases = {
+            "not CUDA": dict(argv=_argv(flag=True), cuda=False),
+            "topk 2": dict(
+                argv=_argv(flag=True, topk=2, draft_tokens=8) + ["--page-size", "1"]
+            ),
+            "pipeline parallelism": dict(argv=_argv(flag=True) + ["--pp-size", "2"]),
+        }
+        for name, case in cases.items():
+            with self.subTest(case=name):
+                args = _launch(**case)
+                self.assertFalse(
+                    resolution_result(args, "enable_speculative_step_cuda_graph")
+                )
+                with _no_switch_set(), _scheduler_process(args):
+                    self.assertEqual(
+                        _values(), {switch.name: False for switch in SWITCHES}
+                    )
+
+    def test_override_on_without_the_flag(self):
+        args = _launch(_argv(flag=False))
+        with _no_switch_set(), _scheduler_process(args):
+            for on in SWITCHES:
+                with self.subTest(switch=on.name):
+                    with mock.patch.dict(os.environ, {on.name: "1"}):
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            _values(),
+                            {switch.name: switch is on for switch in SWITCHES},
+                        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
